{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Ukraine|Ukrainian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Side dishes|Side Dishes]]

'''Nachynka''' in Ukrainian literally means stuffing. This dish is usually not stuffed inside anything, but served as a side dish.

==Ingredients==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (125 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 4.4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*1 cup (140 g / 4.9 oz) [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|cornmeal]]
*3 cups (750 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 1.6 [[Cookbook:Pint|pints]]) homogenized [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*2 large [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*[[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]

==Procedure==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (175°C).
#Melt butter in a pot on medium heat.
#Add cornmeal. Stir mixture to warm up the cornmeal.
#Add milk. Stir until mixture has thickened.
#Beat eggs. Beat in salt, sugar, and baking powder.
#Slowly add some of the thickened cornmeal mixture to the egg mixture while mixing to [[Cookbook:Tempering|temper]] the eggs.
#Stir the egg mixture into the rest of the cornmeal.
#Pour the mixture into a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]].
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 350°F (175°C) for 30–40 minutes or until the top has browned.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*While you are thickening the cornmeal mixture, you have enough time to beat the eggs.
*Doubling the recipe will yield enough to fill a 2 litre casserole dish.
*For different flavour variations:
**Mix in a ¼ teaspoon of [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]].
**Chop up a small onion and cook till tender in the butter, before adding cornmeal.

==Warnings==
*Do not add the egg mixture to the cornmeal. Some of the eggs will cook on impact resulting in streaks of cooked eggs and a heavier Nachynka.
